change.summary: The dedicated server preserves Immersive Aircraft's native sail recipe and accepts the crafted item.

before.reason: The server KubeJS replacement list removed every recipe producing immersive_aircraft:sail.

modifiers.notes: The server registers the exact native 3x3 recipe after its transport-output removals, so recipe availability does not depend on datapack ordering.
The dedicated-server Item Obliterator policy must accept the crafted sail instead of deleting it from player inventory.

rationale.purpose: Restore the sail component needed by the installed Immersive Aircraft progression without enabling the other intentionally disabled transport outputs.
rationale.decision_source: User report and explicit server-only MineRENT update request on 2026-10-16

introduced.summary: Restored the exact native sail recipe and preserved the existing server-side inventory acceptance rule.

history.summary: Removed sail from the broad recipe-output suppression and explicitly registered its native shaped recipe after later synchronization had reintroduced the removal.

notes: Existing clients already contain the unchanged item, model and recipe serializer, so Forge recipe synchronization is sufficient and no client artifact changes.
unresolved: Player acceptance on MineRENT remains pending after deployment.
